files.purpose: Pure text and card decisions for the Victory screen
Thin MonoBehaviour that fills the Victory UXML and returns to Start on any button

integration_notes: Create scene 'Victory' (SceneNames.Victory) and add it to Build Settings after Match.
Scene object: GameObject with UIDocument (Source Asset = Assets/UI/VictoryScreen.uxml, Panel Settings = Assets/UI/RuralRumblePanelSettings.asset) plus VictoryScreenController.
Assign the WrestlerRoster asset to the controller's 'roster' field (used only when the scene is opened directly).
EditMode test assembly needs references to RuralRumble.UI and RuralRumble.Core.
Assets/Art/Arena/arena_backdrop.png must exist and be imported as a Sprite/Texture; a font-size ~80px layout assumes a 1920x1080 reference resolution in PanelSettings.
Scene needs an Input System-capable setup (no extra object required).
assumptions: Reference resolution is 1920x1080 (1600px column and 504px cards fit).
If a wrestler's SelectCard is null, the card shows only the gold border.
Quote label is hidden with display none when empty, and always on a draw.
The no-match fallback is applied inside VictoryText.ResolveResult, called by Build.
If the roster fallback is unavailable and no setup exists, names are blank and cards are hidden.
